title: Profiling campaigns, measurement attribution, and interactive scheduler policy

sources.notes: Models exact nonnegative interval length, two-interval union/intersection, uncovered-time clamping, and fail-closed correlation conceptually. SQLite schema access, arbitrary interval lists, kernel-name details, statistics, and file I/O remain implementation evidence.

Models exclusive bounded control windows, optional and separately tracked profiler state, clock-bound checks, dispatch/row/native-error coverage, exclusive worker evidence, and stop-time cleanup. CUDA synchronization, NVTX, ctypes and poller trace payloads are atomic observations.
Models the exact output/computed/prompt decode predicate, min(baseline, cap), constructor exclusions, and finally restoration. Inherited vLLM scheduling, allocation and fairness remain external.

Models endpoint/output/cache-policy admission, manifest identity, warmup, cold/concurrent/mixed/capacity/cache branches, mixed injection ordering, request/trace fail-closed checks, fixed output lengths, and collector cleanup. Prompt text, HTTP concurrency, subprocesses and telemetry payloads are abstract.

Models the qualification verdict over exactly two complete 32-token outputs, finite prompt/generated logprobs, full trace coverage and exact devices 0 and 1. The source calls this correctness qualification, not performance measurement.
Contract evidence that a connection failure remains an unsuccessful record with an error and traceback rather than becoming a latency sample.

Optional isolated real-server harness for continuous-usage token accounting, first-delivery timing, bundled ITL missingness, HTTP failure exclusion, per-layer row totals, trace/counter agreement and clock bounds. It forbids production port 8017.
CPU contract examples for interval union, symmetric intersection, touching/empty intervals and negative-span rejection.
CPU policy examples for empty, cold, true decode, smaller baseline and recomputation branches.

Campaign dependency that supplies deterministic prompts, authoritative continuous-usage request records, missing bundled ITL, error retention and successful-only summary aggregation; not part of the assigned ownership inventory.
Campaign reuses its Prometheus scraper as a background collector; sampling and JSONL I/O are abstract, and this file is not part of the assigned ownership inventory.
Campaign reuses the PCIe sampler with fixed watched addresses; sysfs details are abstract, and this file is not part of the assigned ownership inventory.

assumptions: The finite request slots and small integer examples preserve ordering, missingness and policy branches but do not represent production scale or timing.
A tracing-disabled campaign still has a live control window, native counter/trace collection and worker evidence; profiler state is independent.
ObservedZero denotes a successfully observed zero duration or count, while Missing denotes unavailable or invalid evidence; failed requests and bundled per-token delivery are not coerced to zero.
Worker control is modeled for the one-CUDA-worker contract enforced by rpc; collective multi-worker behavior is rejected by source.
Native trace coverage is an accounting predicate, not proof of output correctness, causality, kernel critical path or unprofiled performance.
The analyzer's native service interval is a host-observed envelope; it is not Intel kernel duration.
The interactive scheduler is opt-in and not production-registered. vLLM request allocation, ordering, preemption and fairness remain an external dependency.
Qualifying probability data and trace coverage establishes the harness's correctness verdict only; it does not establish latency improvement or production promotion.
No contradiction was observed between the assigned implementations and their focused tests; historical or documentation performance claims are outside this inventory.

implementation_checks.description: CPU-enumerate output/computed/prompt counters for two requests plus baseline/cap, and differentially compare with scheduler.isGenuineDecode and scheduler.interactiveBudget; assert the returned budget never exceeds baseline.
Source-inspect that the temporary max_num_scheduled_tokens assignment surrounds exactly the inherited schedule call and baseline restoration remains in finally for normal and exceptional exits.
CPU-enumerate short nonnegative interval lists and compare union duration with an independent sweep/point-set oracle; separately confirm negative intervals raise ValueError.
CPU-compare overlapLength and unionLength from campaign.ryu against source results for disjoint, touching, overlapping, containing and identical two-interval cases, including symmetry.

On CPU, feed synthetic success, bundled-ITL, failure and no-success records and confirm only successful requests enter latency aggregates, None ITL stays missing, and failed records remain counted with errors.

Using a temporary synthetic SQLite database and worker JSON, compare phase classification, clock-bound intersection, orphan CUDA activity, unmatched native entries, unioned durations and refusal to overwrite an existing output; no hardware is required.

Source-inspect workload enumeration and fail-closed predicates: warmup exclusion from tracing, mixed leader-before-prefill ordering, exact output length, trace coverage, loopback-only endpoint and production-port refusal.
